summary: Iteration 5 — Products CRUD + Site Content editor. Backend: 50/50 pytest pass (24 NEW in test_products_and_content.py + 26 regression in test_admin_v2_api.py). Frontend: admin sidebar shows new admin-nav-content & admin-nav-products entries; ProductsPanel renders 5 seeded products grouped by status; product edit (Pistacchio tagline → TEST QA TAGLINE UI) and restore round-trips against /api/admin/products/{slug} and reflects on public /api/products/{slug}; New product flow (QA Smoke Product, status=future) creates row in Future group and Delete removes it. SiteContent panel renders all 6 tabs (home/collection/ritual/our_story/journal_index/contact); tab switching re-populates fields; editing Home hero_overline → 'QA OVERLINE TEST', Save → save indicator visible, public / hero overline reflects the override; PATCH with empty string restores manifest default and public / reverts. MediaPicker dialog opens from SiteContent image-field Browse button. All public pages (/, /collection, /ritual, /our-story, /journal, /contact) render without JS error.

minor.issue: Storage uses $set: {fields: cleaned} which REPLACES the entire stored override doc. The current frontend SiteContent.jsx appears to send the full form buffer, so it works in the happy path, but any client that sends a partial PATCH will silently wipe other previously-saved overrides. Suggest $set per nested key (fields.<key>) or document the full-buffer requirement. Not blocking — UI flow validated end-to-end.

action_items: (Optional) Make PATCH /api/admin/site-content/{page} merge per-key instead of replacing the whole 'fields' subdoc — guards against partial-update data loss for any future client.

(Optional) Add a public GET /api/admin/products/{slug} (admin variant) — currently admin can only list, not fetch one; the UI works because public /api/products/{slug} still works, but admin viewing of archived products will be impossible (public filters them out).
(Optional) Cleanup obsolete /app/backend/tests/test_admin_api.py (legacy {password}-only login) noted in iteration_4 — still applies.
critical_code_review_comments: Products CRUD endpoints clean: auto-slug, incrementing slug on collision, status validated to {active,future,archived}, slug-collision on PATCH returns 409, empty-name returns 422, double-delete returns 404 — all behaviours match spec and have pytest coverage.

seed_products() correctly switched to insert-only — admin edits to seeded products persist across backend restart. Verified by code inspection (lines 590-602) and round-tripped via API: PATCH tagline → public GET reflects change → restored.
RBAC enforced on every new endpoint: viewer = 403 on /admin/products list/create/delete + /admin/site-content GET/PATCH; editor = 200. Verified via pytest.
SITE_CONTENT_MANIFEST covers all 6 pages with structured sections/fields. Defaults render via _merged_content() with empty-string fallback to manifest default.
Public /api/site-content/home returns a flat {key: value} dict (not nested by section). hero_h1_line1='Not A', hero_h1_italic='Salami.' verified.
Public unknown page → 404. PATCH unknown page → 404. PATCH unknown key → silently dropped (200). All match spec.

Admin UI: ProductsPanel and SiteContentPanel both have proper data-testid coverage (admin-products-panel, admin-site-content-panel, content-tab-{key}, content-field-{key}, products-edit-{slug}, products-delete-{slug}, product-editor-* form fields).
MediaPicker integration works inside both ProductsPanel (ImagesField) and SiteContentPanel (image-type field renders a Browse button that opens media-picker-dialog).
Hot reload on backend respects seed_products insert-only semantics (verified architecturally — no code path re-inserts on existing slug).

MINOR: PATCH /api/admin/site-content uses $set: {fields: cleaned} — wholesale replace. Could lose data on partial updates from third-party clients. Current SiteContent.jsx is unaffected because it submits the full buffer.

MINOR: ProductCreate.status has a Python default of 'active' but no Pydantic Literal/Enum constraint — invalid values are caught only by the manual check in the handler (returns 422 as expected). Consider Literal['active','future','archived'] for self-documentation.

rca of the issue: No bugs found. One minor architectural concern in PATCH /api/admin/site-content/{page}: it does `$set: {fields: cleaned}` which replaces the entire stored override map. The shipped SiteContent.jsx submits the full buffer so this works, but a partial-PATCH from a different client would wipe other keys. Recommend switching to per-key `$set: {f"fields.{key}": value}` mutation or documenting the full-buffer contract. Not blocking the iteration.
